title: Ledger Record (v1)
description: One append-only JSONL run-ledger record (#36) — the producer↔consumer pair this locks is src/ledger/ledger.py build_record (producer) ↔ src/budget/reconcile.py (consumer). reconcile depends on the EXACT cost.* field names (cost.tokens_in, cost.tokens_out, cost.duration_seconds, cost.model), so they are pinned here as a required, fixed-shape nested object whose keys are always present (null when unknown — the file stays uniformly jq-aggregatable). The stage vocabulary is fixed (extend only as the transition seam requires). NOTE the v0 ledger line is the SAME object minus `schema_version`; v1 stamps it additively so existing run-ledger files still parse. Versioning discipline mirrors work-order.v1.

schema_version.description: Version of the Ledger Record contract.

cost.description: Cost block — reconcile.py reads these EXACT field names. Keys always present; null when unknown.

dry_run.description: Whether the tick was a dry run.
